Walking Wake

Water Dragon

Paldea · Generation 9

Walking Wake is a Water/Dragon-type Paradox Pokémon first found in Paldea (Generation 9). It stands 3.5 m tall and weighs 280 kg. It does not evolve. Its highest base stat is Sp. Atk (125), with a base stat total of 590.
